import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/coffee_sales.csv')

# Create figure with subplots
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(18, 12))
fig.suptitle('Coffee Shop Sales Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)

# Define grid for subplots
gs = fig.add_gridspec(3, 3, hspace=0.3, wspace=0.3)

# 1. Revenue by product (top 10)
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 0])
product_revenue = df.groupby('product')['total'].sum().sort_values(ascending=False).head(10)
bars1 = ax1.barh(product_revenue.index, product_revenue.values, color=sns.color_palette('husl', len(product_revenue)))
ax1.set_xlabel('Total Revenue ($)')
ax1.set_title('Top 10 Products by Revenue', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax1.invert_yaxis()
for i, (product, revenue) in enumerate(product_revenue.items()):
    ax1.text(revenue + max(product_revenue.values)*0.005, i, f'${revenue:,.0f}', 
             va='center', fontsize=9)

# 2. Sales distribution by time of day
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 1])
df['hour'] = pd.to_datetime(df['time']).dt.hour
hourly_sales = df.groupby('hour')['total'].sum()
ax2.bar(hourly_sales.index, hourly_sales.values, color='skyblue', edgecolor='navy')
ax2.set_xlabel('Hour of Day')
ax2.set_ylabel('Total Revenue ($)')
ax2.set_title('Revenue by Hour of Day', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_xticks(range(0, 24, 3))
ax2.grid(True, alpha=0.3, axis='y')

# 3. Revenue by age group
ax3 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 2])
age_order = ['18-24', '25-34', '35-44', '45-54', '55+']
age_revenue = df.groupby('customer_age_group')['total'].sum().reindex(age_order)
bars3 = ax3.bar(age_revenue.index, age_revenue.values, color=sns.color_palette('Set2', len(age_revenue)))
ax3.set_xlabel('Age Group')
ax3.set_ylabel('Total Revenue ($)')
ax3.set_title('Revenue by Customer Age Group', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
for i, (age, revenue) in enumerate(age_revenue.items()):
    ax3.text(i, revenue + max(age_revenue.values)*0.01, f'${revenue:,.0f}', 
             ha='center', fontsize=9, rotation=0)

# 4. Takeaway vs Dine-in comparison
ax4 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 0])
takeaway_data = df.groupby('is_takeaway')['total'].sum()
labels = ['Dine-in', 'Takeaway']
colors = ['lightcoral', 'lightgreen']
wedges, texts, autotexts = ax4.pie(takeaway_data.values, labels=labels, colors=colors, 
                                   autopct='%1.1f%%', startangle=90)
ax4.set_title('Revenue: Takeaway vs Dine-in', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
for autotext in autotexts:
    autotext.set_color('black')
    autotext.set_fontweight('bold')

# 5. Payment method distribution
ax5 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1])
payment_data = df.groupby('payment_method')['total'].sum().sort_values(ascending=False)
bars5 = ax5.bar(payment_data.index, payment_data.values, color=sns.color_palette('pastel', len(payment_data)))
ax5.set_xlabel('Payment Method')
ax5.set_ylabel('Total Revenue ($)')
ax5.set_title('Revenue by Payment Method', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax5.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)
for i, (method, revenue) in enumerate(payment_data.items()):
    ax5.text(i, revenue + max(payment_data.values)*0.01, f'${revenue:,.0f}', 
             ha='center', fontsize=9, rotation=0)

# 6. Size preference by product (heatmap)
ax6 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 2])
size_pivot = df.pivot_table(index='product', columns='size', values='quantity', aggfunc='sum', fill_value=0)
top_products = size_pivot.sum(axis=1).sort_values(ascending=False).head(8).index
size_pivot_top = size_pivot.loc[top_products]
sns.heatmap(size_pivot_top, annot=True, fmt='.0f', cmap='YlOrRd', cbar_kws={'label': 'Quantity Sold'}, ax=ax6)
ax6.set_xlabel('Size')
ax6.set_ylabel('Product')
ax6.set_title('Quantity Sold: Product vs Size (Top 8 Products)', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')

# 7. Average transaction value by age group and takeaway status
ax7 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, :])
avg_transaction = df.groupby(['customer_age_group', 'is_takeaway'])['total'].mean().unstack()
avg_transaction = avg_transaction.reindex(age_order)
x = np.arange(len(age_order))
width = 0.35
bars7a = ax7.bar(x - width/2, avg_transaction[0].values, width, label='Dine-in', color='lightcoral')
bars7b = ax7.bar(x + width/2, avg_transaction[1].values, width, label='Takeaway', color='lightgreen')
ax7.set_xlabel('Age Group')
ax7.set_ylabel('Average Transaction Value ($)')
ax7.set_title('Average Transaction Value by Age Group and Takeaway Status', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax7.set_xticks(x)
ax7.set_xticklabels(age_order)
ax7.legend()
ax7.grid(True, alpha=0.3, axis='y')

# Add value labels on bars
for bars in [bars7a, bars7b]:
    for bar in bars:
        height = bar.get_height()
        ax7.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2., height + 0.1,
                f'${height:.2f}', ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=8)

# Adjust layout and save
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
plt.close()
